notes: Toy configuration for adversarial fixture A19 'Interchangeable domains' (VS2-C audit D5).

Two interchangeable normal domains d1 and d2 (both class 'fungible'); two Trials worth 5 and 3; every positive amount is a legal entry; optional allocation; winner-take-all with shared-full ties; no tiebreak before shared.

The two domains are strategically interchangeable: swapping d1<->d2 preserves every per-Trial total and source count, so a domain-swap pair collapses to one behavioural class. This is the only committed fixture whose collapsed count (6) is strictly below its legal count (9) via a GENUINE strategic merge, not equivalence inflation.
Player budget (1 of each domain) and the 9-legal / 6-collapsed / class-sizes {1,1,1,2,2,2} oracle live in the A19 fixture, transcribed from the audit's hand-derivation (REQ-9.4).
